output.summary: The Hartwell AHT drop is real as measured, but it is only partly efficiency. PolicyFind and Fast Path rolled out at all sites in April, and the other sites' AHT stayed flat, so those two do not explain Hartwell's drop. The bonus is the only Hartwell-specific change. Since May, transfers rose from 11.2% to 19.6% and agent releases from 0.5% to 2.3%, clustered at 6-7.5 minutes. Repeat contacts rose 41%, tier-2 wait went from 2 to 9 minutes, and complaints about transfers and call-backs rose. Total minutes per issue barely changed. CSAT is blind to this because the survey excludes transferred and released calls. The hailstorm does not explain the repeat-contact rise. Attrition is confounded by the outsourcer. Do not roll out or disable the release alert. Redesign the incentive and survey first.
